exampleEn: Even though the training is hard, I plan to tough it out until the end.
exampleKo: 훈련이 힘들지만, 나는 끝까지 참고 견닐 계획이야.
gameExamples: When the weather was freezing, we knew we had to tough it out and keep hiking.
During the tough exam, I told myself to tough it out and focus on the questions.
Even with all the challenges we faced, she decided to tough it out and finish the project.
